answer: Day after day the cheese wife sets a pan of milk by the hearth to sour for the morning, covering the pan with a cloth against the flies. Rind ash cheese monger milk patent holds the souring together: a patent ash cheese mongers file after market stall reviews. The vault works the pan, the wharf works the souring, the hollow works the milk. A forger faces 173 false pans and 173 false sourings.
